tool_schemas.name: get_workspace_hierarchy
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached workspace hierarchy snapshot for the given internal workspaceId, including spaces, folders, and lists, and optionally archived entities when includeArchived is true. This endpoint returns a single snapshot (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the workspace is unknown to the integration cache, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the workspace mirror.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id to return the cached hierarchy for.

includeArchived.description: Whether to include archived hierarchy entities in the returned snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ClickUp task in the destination list (resolved by listId, or by listName within the provided workspaceId) and returns the created task record as stored in the integration mirror. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing, if neither listId nor listName is provided, or if any customFields item is missing id/value; raises NOT_FOUND if the destination list (or parent task when parent is set) cannot be resolved in the workspace; raises CONFLICT if listName resolves to multiple lists in the workspace, and FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller lacks permission or exceeds ClickUp/integration rate limits.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id used to resolve names to ClickUp ids and scope creation.

listId.description: Destination ClickUp list id to create the task in (preferred over listName).

listName.description: Human-friendly destination list name to resolve within the workspace (used if listId not provided).

parent.description: Parent task id (ClickUp task id or custom id) to create this task as a subtask.

status.description: Destination status text (must be valid for the list).

assignees.description: Array of ClickUp user ids to assign to the task.

tags.description: Array of tag names to set on the task.

value.description: Custom field value (type depends on field configuration).

customFields.description: Array of custom field updates as {id, value}.

tool_schemas.name: get_task
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single task by taskId (ClickUp task id or custom id), or searches by taskName (optionally narrowed by listName) and returns the matching task; when subtasks is true, the response includes full subtask details. This endpoint returns a single task object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, NOT_FOUND if no task matches the provided identifier(s), and CONFLICT if taskName matches multiple tasks (especially when listName is omitted), as well as FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or limits are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id used to scope lookup when resolving by name.

taskId.description: Task identifier (ClickUp task id or custom id) to fetch.

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name to narrow taskName search for faster/more accurate lookup.

subtasks.description: Whether to include all subtask details in the response.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task identified by taskId (preferred) or by taskName (optionally narrowed by listName) and returns the updated task record from the integration mirror. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no updatable fields are provided, if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, or if any customFields item is missing id/value; raises NOT_FOUND if the task cannot be resolved; raises CONFLICT if taskName resolves to multiple tasks, and FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller is not allowed to modify the task or exceeds rate limits.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id used to scope lookup when resolving by name.

taskId.description: Task identifier (ClickUp task id or custom id) to update (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

listName.description: List name to narrow taskName search (recommended to avoid multiple matches).

status.description: New status text (must be valid for the task's list).

assignees.description: Array of ClickUp user ids to set as assignees.

tags.description: Array of tag names to set on the task.

value.description: Custom field value (type depends on field configuration).

customFields.description: Array of custom field updates as {id, value}.

tool_schemas.name: move_task
tool_schemas.description: Moves a task (identified by taskId or by taskName narrowed by sourceListName) into a destination list (listId preferred, otherwise listName resolved in the workspace) and returns the moved task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no destination list is provided, if taskName is used without sourceListName and the task cannot be uniquely identified, or if required identifiers are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the task, source list, or destination list cannot be resolved; raises CONFLICT if listName resolves to multiple destination lists or taskName matches multiple tasks, and FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the move is not permitted or limits are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id used to resolve list/task names to ClickUp ids.

taskId.description: Task identifier (ClickUp task id or custom id) to move (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

sourceListName.description: Source list name to disambiguate taskName lookup before moving.

listId.description: Destination ClickUp list id (preferred over listName).

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve within the workspace (used if listId not provided).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def move_task(workspaceId, taskId=None, taskName=None, sourceListName=None, listId=None, listName=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0509000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0509000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _is_str(x):
        return isinstance(x, str)

    def _op_log(workspace_id, tool_name, operation_type, request_params, status, error_message=None, resolved_clickup_ids=None, bulk_count=None, succeeded_count=None, failed_count=None, started_at=None, finished_at=None):
        ops = _load("integration_operations.json")
        ts = _now()
        row = {
            "id": _new_id("op"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "operation_type": operation_type,
            "request_params": request_params if isinstance(request_params, dict) else {},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": resolved_clickup_ids,
            "bulk_count": bulk_count,
            "succeeded_count": succeeded_count,
            "failed_count": failed_count,
            "status": status,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": finished_at,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        }
        ops.append(row)
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return row

    t0 = time.time()
    started = _now()

    # Validate inputs
    if not _is_str(workspaceId) or not re.match(r"^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]+$", workspaceId):
        _op_log(workspaceId if _is_str(workspaceId) else "unknown", "move_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", "Invalid workspaceId format", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspaceId format")

    for k, v in [("taskId", taskId), ("taskName", taskName), ("sourceListName", sourceListName), ("listId", listId), ("listName", listName)]:
        if v is not None and not _is_str(v):
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", f"{k} must be a string", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"{k} must be a string")

    if (listId is None or listId.strip() == "") and (listName is None or listName.strip() == ""):
        _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", "Destination listId or listName is required", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Destination listId or listName is required")

    if (taskId is None or taskId.strip() == "") and (taskName is None or taskName.strip() == ""):
        _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", "Either taskId or taskName is required", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either taskId or taskName is required")

    # Resolve workspace and enforce status for write
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    wsp = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspaceId), None)
    if not wsp:
        _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "failed", "Workspace not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found")

    if wsp.get("status") in ("disabled", "read_only"):
        _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", f"Workspace status '{wsp.get('status')}' does not allow write operations", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace does not allow write operations", workspace_status=wsp.get("status"))

    entities = _load("hierarchy_entities.json")
    tasks = _load("tasks.json")

    # Resolve destination list entity
    dest_list = None
    resolved = {}

    if listId is not None and listId.strip() != "":
        matches = [e for e in entities
                   if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                   and e.get("entity_type") == "list"
                   and e.get("status") == "active"
                   and e.get("clickup_id") == listId]
        if not matches:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Destination list not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={"destinationListClickupId": listId})
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination list not found")
        dest_list = matches[0]
        resolved["destinationListClickupId"] = dest_list.get("clickup_id")
    else:
        name = listName.strip() if listName else ""
        candidates = [e for e in entities
                      if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                      and e.get("entity_type") == "list"
                      and e.get("status") == "active"
                      and e.get("name") == name]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Destination listName not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination listName not found")
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "Ambiguous destination listName; provide listId or additional scoping", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={"destinationListName": name, "matches": [c.get("clickup_id") for c in candidates]})
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous destination listName; provide listId", matches=[c.get("clickup_id") for c in candidates])
        dest_list = candidates[0]
        resolved["destinationListClickupId"] = dest_list.get("clickup_id")

    # Resolve source task
    task = None
    if taskId is not None and taskId.strip() != "":
        tid = taskId.strip()
        task = next((t for t in tasks
                     if t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                     and t.get("status") == "active"
                     and (t.get("clickup_task_id") == tid or (t.get("custom_id") == tid and t.get("custom_id") is not None))), None)
        if not task:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Task not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "taskLookup": tid})
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found")
        resolved["taskClickupId"] = task.get("clickup_task_id")
    else:
        # taskName resolution requires sourceListName for this tool per rules
        if sourceListName is None or sourceListName.strip() == "":
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "taskName requires sourceListName to disambiguate", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids=resolved)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "taskName requires sourceListName to disambiguate (provide sourceListName or taskId)")

        src_list_candidates = [e for e in entities
                               if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                               and e.get("entity_type") == "list"
                               and e.get("status") == "active"
                               and e.get("name") == sourceListName.strip()]
        if len(src_list_candidates) == 0:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "sourceListName not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "sourceListName not found")
        if len(src_list_candidates) > 1:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "Ambiguous sourceListName; provide taskId", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={"sourceListName": sourceListName.strip(), "matches": [c.get("clickup_id") for c in src_list_candidates]})
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous sourceListName; provide taskId", matches=[c.get("clickup_id") for c in src_list_candidates])

        src_list = src_list_candidates[0]
        resolved["sourceListClickupId"] = src_list.get("clickup_id")

        name = taskName.strip()
        candidates = [t for t in tasks
                      if t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                      and t.get("status") == "active"
                      and t.get("list_entity_id") == src_list.get("id")
                      and t.get("name") == name]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "taskName did not resolve to a unique task in source list", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "taskName": name},
                    )
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found for taskName in source list")
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "taskName matched multiple tasks in source list", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "taskName": name, "matches": [c.get("clickup_task_id") for c in candidates]},
                    )
            return _err("CONFLICT", "taskName matched multiple tasks in source list", matches=[c.get("clickup_task_id") for c in candidates])
        task = candidates[0]
        resolved["taskClickupId"] = task.get("clickup_task_id")

    # Enforce list FK constraint: destination list must be active
    if dest_list.get("status") != "active":
        _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "failed", "Destination list is not active", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                resolved_clickup_ids=resolved)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Destination list is not active")

    # No success without effect: if already in destination list, treat as idempotent success? Move implies change; ClickUp would likely no-op.
    # We'll be idempotent and still return the task, but must record as succeeded with no mutation? Contract says no success without effect for mutation matched no row; here row exists.
    # We'll still update updated_at and raw marker to reflect "moved" for observability.
    old_list_id = task.get("list_entity_id")
    task_changed = (old_list_id != dest_list.get("id"))

    # Apply move
    ts = _now()
    for i, t in enumerate(tasks):
        if t.get("id") == task.get("id"):
            tasks[i] = dict(t)
            tasks[i]["list_entity_id"] = dest_list.get("id")
            # Potentially clear status_text when moving (rule allows clear/remap)
            if task_changed:
                tasks[i]["status_text"] = None
            # Record final value from ClickUp in raw/status_text (we don't have ClickUp; store minimal raw marker)
            raw = tasks[i].get("raw") if isinstance(tasks[i].get("raw"), dict) else {}
            raw = dict(raw)
            raw["integration_move"] = {
                "from_list_entity_id": old_list_id,
                "to_list_entity_id": dest_list.get("id"),
                "moved_at": ts
            }
            tasks[i]["raw"] = raw
            tasks[i]["updated_at"] = ts
            task = tasks[i]
            break

    _save("tasks.json", tasks)

    finished = _now()
    _op_log(workspaceId, "move_task", "write",
            {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
            "succeeded", None, resolved_clickup_ids=resolved, started_at=started, finished_at=finished)

    return {
        "task": task,
        "moved": True,
        "from_list_entity_id": old_list_id,
        "to_list_entity_id": dest_list.get("id"),
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
    }

tool_schemas.name: duplicate_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing task (identified by taskId or by taskName narrowed by sourceListName) into the specified destination list (defaults to the original list when listId/listName are omitted) and returns the duplicated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither taskId nor taskName is provided, or if taskName is used without sourceListName and cannot be uniquely identified; raises NOT_FOUND if the source task or destination list cannot be resolved; raises CONFLICT if taskName matches multiple tasks or listName resolves to multiple lists, and FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if duplication is not allowed or limits are exceeded.

workspaceId.description: Internal workspace id used to resolve list/task names to ClickUp ids.

taskId.description: Task identifier (ClickUp task id or custom id) to duplicate (preferred).

taskName.description: Task name to search for when taskId is not provided.

sourceListName.description: Source list name to disambiguate taskName lookup for duplication.

listId.description: Destination ClickUp list id to place the duplicate into (defaults to original list).

listName.description: Destination list name to resolve within the workspace (used if listId not provided; defaults to original list).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def duplicate_task(workspaceId, taskId=None, taskName=None, sourceListName=None, listId=None, listName=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, re, copy

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0509000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0509000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _is_str(x):
        return isinstance(x, str)

    def _op_log(workspace_id, tool_name, operation_type, request_params, status, error_message=None, resolved_clickup_ids=None, bulk_count=None, succeeded_count=None, failed_count=None, started_at=None, finished_at=None):
        ops = _load("integration_operations.json")
        ts = _now()
        row = {
            "id": _new_id("op"),
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "operation_type": operation_type,
            "request_params": request_params if isinstance(request_params, dict) else {},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": resolved_clickup_ids,
            "bulk_count": bulk_count,
            "succeeded_count": succeeded_count,
            "failed_count": failed_count,
            "status": status,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "started_at": started_at,
            "finished_at": finished_at,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        }
        ops.append(row)
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return row

    t0 = time.time()
    started = _now()

    if not _is_str(workspaceId) or not re.match(r"^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]+$", workspaceId):
        _op_log(workspaceId if _is_str(workspaceId) else "unknown", "duplicate_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", "Invalid workspaceId format", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspaceId format")

    for k, v in [("taskId", taskId), ("taskName", taskName), ("sourceListName", sourceListName), ("listId", listId), ("listName", listName)]:
        if v is not None and not _is_str(v):
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", f"{k} must be a string", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"{k} must be a string")

    if (taskId is None or taskId.strip() == "") and (taskName is None or taskName.strip() == ""):
        _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", "Either taskId or taskName is required", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either taskId or taskName is required")

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    wsp = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspaceId), None)
    if not wsp:
        _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "failed", "Workspace not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found")

    if wsp.get("status") in ("disabled", "read_only"):
        _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "rejected", f"Workspace status '{wsp.get('status')}' does not allow write operations", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace does not allow write operations", workspace_status=wsp.get("status"))

    entities = _load("hierarchy_entities.json")
    tasks = _load("tasks.json")

    resolved = {}

    # Resolve source task
    src_task = None
    if taskId is not None and taskId.strip() != "":
        tid = taskId.strip()
        src_task = next((t for t in tasks
                         if t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                         and t.get("status") == "active"
                         and (t.get("clickup_task_id") == tid or (t.get("custom_id") == tid and t.get("custom_id") is not None))), None)
        if not src_task:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Source task not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={"taskLookup": tid})
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Source task not found")
        resolved["taskClickupId"] = src_task.get("clickup_task_id")
    else:
        if sourceListName is None or sourceListName.strip() == "":
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "taskName requires sourceListName to disambiguate", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "taskName requires sourceListName to disambiguate (provide sourceListName or taskId)")

        src_list_candidates = [e for e in entities
                               if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                               and e.get("entity_type") == "list"
                               and e.get("status") == "active"
                               and e.get("name") == sourceListName.strip()]
        if len(src_list_candidates) == 0:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "sourceListName not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "sourceListName not found")
        if len(src_list_candidates) > 1:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "Ambiguous sourceListName; provide taskId", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={"sourceListName": sourceListName.strip(), "matches": [c.get("clickup_id") for c in src_list_candidates]})
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous sourceListName; provide taskId", matches=[c.get("clickup_id") for c in src_list_candidates])

        src_list = src_list_candidates[0]
        resolved["sourceListClickupId"] = src_list.get("clickup_id")

        name = taskName.strip()
        candidates = [t for t in tasks
                      if t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                      and t.get("status") == "active"
                      and t.get("list_entity_id") == src_list.get("id")
                      and t.get("name") == name]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "taskName did not resolve to a unique task in source list", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "taskName": name})
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found for taskName in source list")
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "taskName matched multiple tasks in source list", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "taskName": name, "matches": [c.get("clickup_task_id") for c in candidates]})
            return _err("CONFLICT", "taskName matched multiple tasks in source list", matches=[c.get("clickup_task_id") for c in candidates])
        src_task = candidates[0]
        resolved["taskClickupId"] = src_task.get("clickup_task_id")

    # Resolve destination list: default to source list if omitted
    dest_list_entity = None
    if (listId is None or listId.strip() == "") and (listName is None or listName.strip() == ""):
        dest_list_entity = next((e for e in entities if e.get("id") == src_task.get("list_entity_id")), None)
        if not dest_list_entity or dest_list_entity.get("entity_type") != "list" or dest_list_entity.get("status") == "deleted":
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Source task list not found/invalid", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids=resolved)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Source task list not found/invalid")
        resolved["destinationListClickupId"] = dest_list_entity.get("clickup_id")
    elif listId is not None and listId.strip() != "":
        matches = [e for e in entities
                   if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                   and e.get("entity_type") == "list"
                   and e.get("status") == "active"
                   and e.get("clickup_id") == listId.strip()]
        if not matches:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Destination list not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "destinationListClickupId": listId.strip()})
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination list not found")
        dest_list_entity = matches[0]
        resolved["destinationListClickupId"] = dest_list_entity.get("clickup_id")
    else:
        name = listName.strip()
        candidates = [e for e in entities
                      if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId
                      and e.get("entity_type") == "list"
                      and e.get("status") == "active"
                      and e.get("name") == name]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "failed", "Destination listName not found", started_at=started, finished_at=_now())
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination listName not found")
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                    {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                    "rejected", "Ambiguous destination listName; provide listId", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                    resolved_clickup_ids={**resolved, "destinationListName": name, "matches": [c.get("clickup_id") for c in candidates]})
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous destination listName; provide listId", matches=[c.get("clickup_id") for c in candidates])
        dest_list_entity = candidates[0]
        resolved["destinationListClickupId"] = dest_list_entity.get("clickup_id")

    if dest_list_entity.get("status") != "active":
        _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
                {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
                "failed", "Destination list is not active", started_at=started, finished_at=_now(),
                resolved_clickup_ids=resolved)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Destination list is not active")

    # Create duplicate task row; parent_task_id null unless ClickUp duplicates as subtask (not supported here)
    ts = _now()
    new_task_internal_id = _new_id("tsk")
    new_clickup_task_id = _new_id("cu_task")  # synthetic ClickUp id placeholder for offline integration cache

    # Unique(workspace_id, clickup_task_id)
    if any(t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId and t.get("clickup_task_id") == new_clickup_task_id for t in tasks):
        new_clickup_task_id = _new_id("cu_task")

    dup = {
        "id": new_task_internal_id,
        "workspace_id": workspaceId,
        "clickup_task_id": new_clickup_task_id,
        "custom_id": None,
        "list_entity_id": dest_list_entity.get("id"),
        "parent_task_id": None,
        "name": src_task.get("name"),
        "description": src_task.get("description"),
        "status_text": src_task.get("status_text"),
        "priority": src_task.get("priority"),
        "due_date": src_task.get("due_date"),
        "start_date": src_task.get("start_date"),
        "assignee_clickup_user_ids": copy.deepcopy(src_task.get("assignee_clickup_user_ids")),
        "custom_fields": copy.deepcopy(src_task.get("custom_fields")),
        "tag_names": copy.deepcopy(src_task.get("tag_names")),
        "status": "active",
        "last_synced_at": None,
        "raw": {},
        "created_at": ts,
        "updated_at": ts,
    }

    raw = {}
    raw["integration_duplicate"] = {
        "source_task_id": src_task.get("id"),
        "source_clickup_task_id": src_task.get("clickup_task_id"),
        "created_at": ts
    }
    dup["raw"] = raw

    tasks.append(dup)
    _save("tasks.json", tasks)

    finished = _now()
    _op_log(workspaceId, "duplicate_task", "write",
            {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "sourceListName": sourceListName, "listId": listId, "listName": listName},
            "succeeded", None, resolved_clickup_ids=resolved, started_at=started, finished_at=finished)

    return {
        "task": dup,
        "source_task": src_task,
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
    }

tool_schemas.implementation:
def move_bulk_tasks(workspaceId, tasks, targetListId=None, targetListName=None, options=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, base64, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0509000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0509000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # ---- validation helpers ----
    wsp_pat = re.compile(r"^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$")
    ent_pat = re.compile(r"^cu_ent_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$")
    tsk_pat = re.compile(r"^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]{3,}$")

    def _parse_int_cursor(cur):
        if cur is None:
            return 0
        if not isinstance(cur, str) or not cur:
            return None
        if not cur.startswith("off:"):
            return None
        try:
            v = int(cur.split(":", 1)[1])
            return v if v >= 0 else None
        except Exception:
            return None

    # ---- load store ----
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    entities = _load("hierarchy_entities.json")
    tasks_rows = _load("tasks.json")
    ops = _load("integration_operations.json")

    # ---- resolve workspace + permission gating ----
    if not isinstance(workspaceId, str) or not wsp_pat.match(workspaceId):
        # log rejected
        op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|bad_workspace").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId if isinstance(workspaceId, str) else "unknown",
            "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
            "bulk_count": len(tasks) if isinstance(tasks, list) else None,
            "succeeded_count": 0,
            "failed_count": len(tasks) if isinstance(tasks, list) else None,
            "status": "rejected",
            "error_message": "workspaceId is invalid",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspaceId is invalid", field="workspaceId")

    workspace = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspaceId), None)
    if not workspace:
        op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|workspace_not_found").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
            "bulk_count": len(tasks) if isinstance(tasks, list) else None,
            "succeeded_count": 0,
            "failed_count": len(tasks) if isinstance(tasks, list) else None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "workspace not found",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found", workspaceId=workspaceId)

    if workspace.get("status") in ("disabled", "read_only"):
        op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|workspace_rejected|" + workspace.get("status","")).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
            "bulk_count": len(tasks) if isinstance(tasks, list) else None,
            "succeeded_count": 0,
            "failed_count": len(tasks) if isinstance(tasks, list) else None,
            "status": "rejected",
            "error_message": f"workspace is {workspace.get('status')}; write operations are not allowed",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Write operations are not allowed for this workspace", workspaceStatus=workspace.get("status"))

    # ---- validate tasks array ----
    if not isinstance(tasks, list) or len(tasks) < 1:
        op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|bad_tasks").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
            "bulk_count": None,
            "succeeded_count": 0,
            "failed_count": None,
            "status": "rejected",
            "error_message": "tasks must be a non-empty array",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tasks must be a non-empty array", field="tasks")

    # validate options
    batchSize = None
    concurrency = None
    if options is not None:
        if not isinstance(options, dict):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "options must be an object", field="options")
        if "batchSize" in options:
            if not isinstance(options["batchSize"], int) or options["batchSize"] < 1:
                return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "options.batchSize must be an integer >= 1", field="options.batchSize")
            batchSize = options["batchSize"]
        if "concurrency" in options:
            if not isinstance(options["concurrency"], int) or options["concurrency"] < 1:
                return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "options.concurrency must be an integer >= 1", field="options.concurrency")
            concurrency = options["concurrency"]
    # not used for offline server-side, but validated.

    # ---- resolve destination list ----
    resolved = {"targetListEntityId": None}
    dest_list_ent = None
    if targetListId is not None:
        if not isinstance(targetListId, str) or not ent_pat.match(targetListId):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "targetListId is invalid", field="targetListId")
        dest_list_ent = next((e for e in entities if e.get("id") == targetListId and e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId), None)
        if not dest_list_ent:
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination list not found", targetListId=targetListId)
        if dest_list_ent.get("entity_type") != "list" or dest_list_ent.get("status") != "active":
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Destination must be an active list", targetListId=targetListId)
        resolved["targetListEntityId"] = dest_list_ent.get("id")
    else:
        if targetListName is None or not isinstance(targetListName, str) or not targetListName.strip():
            # log rejected
            op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|missing_target").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
                "operation_type": "write",
                "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
                "resolved_clickup_ids": resolved,
                "bulk_count": len(tasks),
                "succeeded_count": 0,
                "failed_count": len(tasks),
                "status": "rejected",
                "error_message": "targetListId or targetListName is required",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })
            _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "targetListId or targetListName is required")
        # name-based list resolution: reject ambiguity unless scoped; this tool has no scope params, so must be unique
        candidates = [e for e in entities if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId and e.get("entity_type") == "list" and e.get("status") == "active" and e.get("name") == targetListName]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination list not found by name", targetListName=targetListName)
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|ambiguous_target_list").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
                "operation_type": "write",
                "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
                "resolved_clickup_ids": resolved,
                "bulk_count": len(tasks),
                "succeeded_count": 0,
                "failed_count": len(tasks),
                "status": "rejected",
                "error_message": "Ambiguous targetListName; provide targetListId",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })
            _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous targetListName; provide targetListId", targetListName=targetListName, matches=len(candidates))
        dest_list_ent = candidates[0]
        resolved["targetListEntityId"] = dest_list_ent.get("id")

    # precompute list-name => list-entity-id mapping for scoping taskName lookups
    active_lists_by_name = {}
    for e in entities:
        if e.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId and e.get("entity_type") == "list" and e.get("status") == "active":
            nm = e.get("name")
            if isinstance(nm, str):
                active_lists_by_name.setdefault(nm, []).append(e)

    # ---- resolve each task reference; enforce name-based rules ----
    resolved_task_ids = []
    per_item_errors = []
    for idx, item in enumerate(tasks):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "task item must be an object"})
            continue
        taskId = item.get("taskId")
        taskName = item.get("taskName")
        listName = item.get("listName")
        if taskId is not None:
            if not isinstance(taskId, str) or not tsk_pat.match(taskId):
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "taskId is invalid"})
                continue
            tr = next((t for t in tasks_rows if t.get("id") == taskId and t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId), None)
            if not tr:
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "taskId not found", "taskId": taskId})
                continue
            if tr.get("status") != "active":
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "task is not active", "taskId": taskId})
                continue
            resolved_task_ids.append(taskId)
        else:
            # must have taskName + listName (bulk resolution must be scoped to list)
            if not isinstance(taskName, str) or not taskName.strip():
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "taskName is required when taskId is not provided"})
                continue
            if not isinstance(listName, str) or not listName.strip():
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "listName is required when identifying a task by taskName"})
                continue
            list_candidates = active_lists_by_name.get(listName, [])
            if len(list_candidates) == 0:
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "listName not found", "listName": listName})
                continue
            if len(list_candidates) > 1:
                # tool lacks space/folder scope; reject ambiguity
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "ambiguous listName; provide taskId", "listName": listName, "matches": len(list_candidates)})
                continue
            list_ent_id = list_candidates[0].get("id")
            candidates = [t for t in tasks_rows if t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId and t.get("status") == "active" and t.get("list_entity_id") == list_ent_id and t.get("name") == taskName]
            if len(candidates) == 0:
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "no task found for (taskName, listName)", "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName})
                continue
            if len(candidates) > 1:
                per_item_errors.append({"index": idx, "error": "ambiguous taskName within list; use taskId", "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "matches": len(candidates)})
                continue
            resolved_task_ids.append(candidates[0].get("id"))

    if per_item_errors:
        # Reject whole operation per bulk resolution rule (0 or >1 candidates in any item -> rejected)
        op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((now + "|move_bulk_tasks|resolution_rejected").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": {"destination": resolved, "task_ids": resolved_task_ids},
            "bulk_count": len(tasks),
            "succeeded_count": 0,
            "failed_count": len(tasks),
            "status": "rejected",
            "error_message": "Task resolution failed for one or more items",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Task resolution failed for one or more items", details=per_item_errors)

    # ---- perform moves (real mutation) ----
    started = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    op_id = "cu_op_" + hashlib.sha1((started + "|move_bulk_tasks|" + workspaceId).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12].upper()
    op_row = {
        "id": op_id,
        "workspace_id": workspaceId,
        "tool_name": "move_bulk_tasks",
        "operation_type": "write",
        "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "targetListId": targetListId, "targetListName": targetListName, "tasks": tasks, "options": options},
        "resolved_clickup_ids": {"destination": resolved, "task_ids": list(resolved_task_ids)},
        "bulk_count": len(resolved_task_ids),
        "succeeded_count": 0,
        "failed_count": 0,
        "status": "in_progress",
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": started,
        "finished_at": None,
        "created_at": started,
        "updated_at": started
    }
    ops.append(op_row)
    _save("integration_operations.json", ops)

    updated_tasks = []
    succeeded = 0
    failed = 0

    # destination "workflow" compatibility is unknown; we may clear status_text on cross-list move.
    for tid in resolved_task_ids:
        tr = next((t for t in tasks_rows if t.get("id") == tid and t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId), None)
        if not tr or tr.get("status") != "active":
            failed += 1
            continue

        old_list = tr.get("list_entity_id")
        tr["list_entity_id"] = dest_list_ent.get("id")
        if old_list != tr["list_entity_id"]:
            # may clear status_text on move; record in raw that it was reset
            tr["status_text"] = None
            raw = tr.get("raw") if isinstance(tr.get("raw"), dict) else {}
            raw["moved_at"] = now
            raw["moved_from_list_entity_id"] = old_list
            raw["moved_to_list_entity_id"] = dest_list_ent.get("id")
            raw["status_text_after_move"] = tr["status_text"]
            tr["raw"] = raw

        tr["updated_at"] = now
        succeeded += 1
        updated_tasks.append(tr)

    if succeeded == 0:
        # mutation matched none effectively -> NOT_FOUND
        # update op to failed
        finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
        for o in ops:
            if o.get("id") == op_id:
                o["status"] = "failed"
                o["error_message"] = "No tasks were moved"
                o["succeeded_count"] = 0
                o["failed_count"] = len(resolved_task_ids)
                o["finished_at"] = finished
                o["updated_at"] = finished
                break
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "No tasks were moved")

    _save("tasks.json", tasks_rows)

    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    for o in ops:
        if o.get("id") == op_id:
            o["status"] = "succeeded" if failed == 0 else "failed"
            o["succeeded_count"] = succeeded
            o["failed_count"] = failed
            o["finished_at"] = finished
            o["updated_at"] = finished
            if failed:
                o["error_message"] = "One or more tasks could not be moved"
            break
    _save("integration_operations.json", ops)

    return {
        "operation": op_row,
        "destination_list": dest_list_ent,
        "tasks": updated_tasks,
        "succeeded_count": succeeded,
        "failed_count": failed,
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    }

tool_schemas.name: delete_bulk_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes multiple tasks (no recovery) and returns a per-task deletion outcome for the submitted identifiers, recording the operation in the workspace audit log. Each task is identified by taskId (recommended) or by (taskName + listName) resolved from the cached hierarchy, and deletions are executed in batches using options.batchSize with up to options.concurrency concurrent upstream requests; this endpoint is not paged and returns a single aggregated result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId is invalid, tasks is empty, or a task item provides neither taskId nor (taskName and listName); raises NOT_FOUND if a task cannot be resolved or no longer exists; raises CONFLICT if deletion is refused by ClickUp due to task state or permissions; raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid authorization and RATE_LIMITED when upstream quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: start_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Starts a running time entry for a task (identified by taskId, or by taskName optionally disambiguated by listName) and returns the newly created running time entry as stored, including description, billable flag, tags, and start time. Only one timer may be running at a time for the connected ClickUp user/context; if a timer is already running, the start request is refused rather than implicitly stopping the existing timer. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspaceId is invalid or the task identifier cannot be resolved; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace/task does not exist in the cache; raises CONFLICT if a time entry is already running or ClickUp refuses starting a timer for the task’s current state; raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid authorization and RATE_LIMITED when upstream quota is exceeded.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: Optional tag names to apply to the time entry.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def start_time_tracking(workspaceId, taskId=None, taskName=None, listName=None, description=None, billable=None, tags=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0509000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0509000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(workspaceId, str) or not re.match(r"^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]+$", workspaceId):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspaceId is invalid; expected pattern ^cu_wsp_[0-9A-Z]+$")

    if taskId is not None and (not isinstance(taskId, str) or not re.match(r"^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]+$", taskId)):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "taskId is invalid; expected pattern ^cu_tsk_[0-9A-Z]+$")
    if taskName is not None and not isinstance(taskName, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "taskName must be a string")
    if listName is not None and not isinstance(listName, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "listName must be a string")
    if description is not None and not isinstance(description, str):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "description must be a string")
    if billable is not None and not isinstance(billable, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "billable must be a boolean")
    if tags is not None:
        if not isinstance(tags, list) or any((not isinstance(x, str)) for x in tags):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "tags must be an array of strings")

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    tasks = _load("tasks.json")
    time_entries = _load("time_entries.json")
    ops = _load("integration_operations.json")
    hierarchy = _load("hierarchy_entities.json")

    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspaceId), None)
    if not ws:
        # Log op as failed (not found is not "rejected" business-rule wise, but must be logged)
        op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
            "bulk_count": None,
            "succeeded_count": None,
            "failed_count": None,
            "status": "failed",
            "error_message": "Workspace not found",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found", workspaceId=workspaceId)

    # Enforce workspace status for write operations
    if ws.get("status") in ("disabled", "read_only"):
        op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
            "bulk_count": None,
            "succeeded_count": None,
            "failed_count": None,
            "status": "rejected",
            "error_message": f"Workspace is {ws.get('status')}; write operations are not allowed",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace does not allow write operations in its current status", status=ws.get("status"))

    # Resolve task
    resolved = {}
    target_task = None

    def _list_id_by_name_scoped(ws_id, ln):
        # listName resolution is only for disambiguating taskName; allow multiple lists with same name -> ambiguous
        cands = [e for e in hierarchy if e.get("workspace_id") == ws_id and e.get("entity_type") == "list" and e.get("status") == "active" and e.get("name") == ln]
        if len(cands) == 1:
            return cands[0].get("id"), cands[0]
        if len(cands) == 0:
            return None, None
        return "__AMBIG__", None

    if taskId is not None:
        target_task = next((t for t in tasks if t.get("id") == taskId and t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId), None)
        if not target_task:
            op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
                "operation_type": "write",
                "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
                "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
                "bulk_count": None,
                "succeeded_count": None,
                "failed_count": None,
                "status": "failed",
                "error_message": "Task not found",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })
            _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found", taskId=taskId)
        if target_task.get("status") != "active":
            op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
                "operation_type": "write",
                "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
                "resolved_clickup_ids": {"taskId": taskId},
                "bulk_count": None,
                "succeeded_count": None,
                "failed_count": None,
                "status": "rejected",
                "error_message": "Cannot track time on a deleted task",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })
            _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Cannot start time tracking on a non-active task", status=target_task.get("status"))
        resolved["taskId"] = taskId
        resolved["clickupTaskId"] = target_task.get("clickup_task_id")
    else:
        if not taskName or not isinstance(taskName, str) or not taskName.strip():
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Either taskId or a non-empty taskName must be provided")
        # If listName provided, resolve to a list and use it to scope taskName matching
        scoped_list_entity_id = None
        if listName is not None:
            lid, lrow = _list_id_by_name_scoped(workspaceId, listName)
            if lid is None:
                op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
                ops.append({
                    "id": op_id,
                    "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                    "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
                    "operation_type": "write",
                    "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": None, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
                    "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
                    "bulk_count": None,
                    "succeeded_count": None,
                    "failed_count": None,
                    "status": "rejected",
                    "error_message": "listName could not be resolved to an active list",
                    "started_at": now,
                    "finished_at": now,
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now
                })
                _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
                return _err("NOT_FOUND", "List not found for listName", listName=listName)
            if lid == "__AMBIG__":
                op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
                ops.append({
                    "id": op_id,
                    "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                    "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
                    "operation_type": "write",
                    "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": None, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
                    "resolved_clickup_ids": None,
                    "bulk_count": None,
                    "succeeded_count": None,
                    "failed_count": None,
                    "status": "rejected",
                    "error_message": "Ambiguous listName; multiple active lists share this name",
                    "started_at": now,
                    "finished_at": now,
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now
                })
                _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
                return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous listName; multiple matches", listName=listName)
            scoped_list_entity_id = lid
            resolved["listName"] = listName
            resolved["listEntityId"] = scoped_list_entity_id

        cands = [t for t in tasks if t.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId and t.get("status") == "active" and t.get("name") == taskName]
        if scoped_list_entity_id is not None:
            cands = [t for t in cands if t.get("list_entity_id") == scoped_list_entity_id]

        if len(cands) != 1:
            op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
            ops.append({
                "id": op_id,
                "workspace_id": workspaceId,
                "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
                "operation_type": "write",
                "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": None, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
                "resolved_clickup_ids": {"taskName": taskName, "listName": listName} if listName is not None else {"taskName": taskName},
                "bulk_count": None,
                "succeeded_count": None,
                "failed_count": None,
                "status": "rejected",
                "error_message": "taskName resolution yielded 0 or multiple candidates; provide taskId (preferred) or further disambiguation",
                "started_at": now,
                "finished_at": now,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })
            _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Ambiguous or missing taskName match", matched=len(cands))
        target_task = cands[0]
        resolved["taskId"] = target_task.get("id")
        resolved["clickupTaskId"] = target_task.get("clickup_task_id")

    # Policy: refuse if a timer is already running in this workspace
    running = [te for te in time_entries if te.get("workspace_id") == workspaceId and te.get("status") == "running" and te.get("is_running") is True]
    if len(running) > 0:
        op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
        ops.append({
            "id": op_id,
            "workspace_id": workspaceId,
            "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
            "operation_type": "write",
            "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": target_task.get("id"), "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
            "resolved_clickup_ids": resolved,
            "bulk_count": None,
            "succeeded_count": None,
            "failed_count": None,
            "status": "rejected",
            "error_message": "A time entry is already running; implicit stop is not allowed for this endpoint",
            "started_at": now,
            "finished_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("integration_operations.json", ops)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "A time entry is already running", runningTimeEntryId=running[0].get("id"))

    # Create running time entry
    te_id = "cu_tim_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
    clickup_te_id = "clk_tim_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
    row = {
        "id": te_id,
        "workspace_id": workspaceId,
        "task_id": target_task.get("id"),
        "clickup_time_entry_id": clickup_te_id,
        "clickup_user_id": None,
        "description": description,
        "billable": billable,
        "tag_names": tags if tags is not None else None,
        "start_at": now,
        "end_at": None,
        "duration_ms": None,
        "is_running": True,
        "source": "timer",
        "status": "running",
        "raw": {"started_via": "start_time_tracking", "resolved": resolved, "task_clickup_task_id": target_task.get("clickup_task_id")},
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }
    time_entries.append(row)

    # Log op succeeded
    op_id = "cu_op_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()
    finished = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"
    ops.append({
        "id": op_id,
        "workspace_id": workspaceId,
        "tool_name": "start_time_tracking",
        "operation_type": "write",
        "request_params": {"workspaceId": workspaceId, "taskId": taskId, "taskName": taskName, "listName": listName, "description": description, "billable": billable, "tags": tags},
        "resolved_clickup_ids": resolved,
        "bulk_count": None,
        "succeeded_count": None,
        "failed_count": None,
        "status": "succeeded",
        "error_message": None,
        "started_at": now,
        "finished_at": finished,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": finished
    })

    _save("time_entries.json", time_entries)
    _save("integration_operations.json", ops)

    return {
        "time_entry": row,
        "meta": {
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "operation_id": op_id
        }
    }
